blocks.text: Bar charts alag alag categories ka comparison (muqabla) karne ke liye behtareen hain. Har bar ek category hai, aur bar ki height (unchai) ya length (lambai) us category ki qeemat batati hai.
Misal: Socho aap dukaan mein alag alag products ki sales ka comparison karna chahte hain. Bar chart yeh data tasveer mein dikha sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Bar chart jis ka title Sales on Day 1 and Day 2 for various items hai. Y-axis (khari line), Number of products sold, 1000 tak. Chaar jore bars (Day 1 neela, Day 2 peela): 800 aur 600; 800 aur 1000; 1000 aur 600; 400 aur 600.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.4: Alag alag products ki sales dikhane wala bar chart (kitab ki Figure 5.4 jaisa hamara apna diagram).

blocks.text: Yeh program text se bar chart banata hai: har * 100 products ke barabar hai. day_1 ya day_2 ki sales badal kar Run karein aur bars ki lambai badalte dekhein.

items = ["Item 1", "Item 2", "Item 3", "Item 4"]
day_1 = [800, 800, 1000, 400]
day_2 = [600, 1000, 600, 600]
each_star = 100   # one * = 100 products

for item, d1, d2 in zip(items, day_1, day_2):
    print(item, "Day 1 |", "*" * (d1 // each_star), d1)
    print(" " * len(item), "Day 2 |", "*" * (d2 // each_star), d2)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"items", "day_1", "day_2": chaar products aur do dinon ki sales.
"each_star = 100": har * 100 products ke barabar hai.
"for item, d1, d2 in zip(items, day_1, day_2):": zip() har product ka naam aur dono dinon ki sales saath deta hai.
"d1 // each_star": "//" floor division hai, yani taqseem ka sirf poora hissa (800 // 100 = 8). Agar sale 450 ho to 4 stars hi banenge.
"*" * 8: kisi string ko number se zarb dene par woh utni baar dohrayi jati hai: ********.
" " * len(item): Day 2 wali line mein naam ki jagah utni hi spaces, taa ke dono bars ek seedh mein aayein.
Output: har product ki do bars: Item 1 (8 aur 6 stars, 800 / 600), Item 2 (8 aur 10, 800 / 1000), Item 3 (10 aur 6, 1000 / 600), Item 4 (4 aur 6, 400 / 600).
Khud try karein: day_1 mein aakhri 400 ko 1200 kar dein: Item 4 Day 1 ki bar 12 stars lambi ho jayegi.

blocks.prompt: Day 1 aur Day 2 ki sales ke liye saath saath (grouped) bars kyun useful (kaam ke) hain?
blocks.explanation: Har product ki do bars saath saath hoti hain, is liye har product ke liye dono dinon ka farq foran nazar aata hai.

items: Bar chart: categories ki qeematon ka comparison.
